objectives.name: the escalators
objectives.text: Through the atrium and up the escalators

objectives.name: the north wing
objectives.text: Across the walkway and up to the wing

objectives.name: Hargrove and Sons
objectives.text: Through the wing to the department store

radio.line: Welcome to the Meridian Mall, folks! Tonight's main event: one courier versus a whole lot of hungry neighbours.
It's an arena, Parker. Don't stop moving in there.
Open the gates! Let 'em out!
And he's into the food court! Sorry, folks, food court's closed. Has been for twenty years.
This segment is brought to you by the Ward. Clean water, for people who know their place.
Parker, far walkway. That's... oh, that's Juno.
Hey, stranger. Keep up.
She's working for him?
Two years now. Her block's taps went dry. I'll tell you the rest when you're not getting shot at.
Into Hargrove and Sons! Mind the perfume counter, folks. My boys are working it tonight.
Now, Parker, while you're browsing, a word from our... what is that? Who's on my frequency?
Porch light's on, courier. I'm coming home.
Technical difficulties, folks. Nobody touch anything.
That was her.
That was her. She's alive. She's in his wires, Parker. Go. Run.
He's on the skybridge! And guess who's waiting for him at the other end. Go on. Guess.

kill.line: Down goes another! Folks, I'm starting to feel sorry for them. No, I'm not.
Good. Don't wait for the next one, go.
Splat! Right by the fountain, too. Nobody's drinking that.
That's one. Keep your head up, they jump.
And down goes another one! The crowd goes mild.
Oh, he was employee of the month! Well. Of a month.
Good. Don't let the big ones corner you.
Another one off the shop floor! No refunds.

headshot.line: Oh! Right in the... well, I think that was the head.
Pop! Hear that? That's the sound of ratings.
Nice. Watch the railings, they come over.
Right between the eyes! Run that back!
Somebody call security. Oh, wait. That was security.

down.line: And he's lunch! Oh, no, wait, he's back. Never mind.
Up. Keep moving, they'll swarm you if you stop.
Courier down in the Atrium! Mind your step, it's very... chewy in there.
Ooh! That one's going in the highlights.
Up. Don't stand still in here.
Courier down! Lie there a while, everything's half off.
Up. Don't fight the big ones head on.
And he's down! Folks, I think that one broke something. Not him, the shelf.
And our courier's in the bargain bin!
Up. Get round them, don't stand in front of them.

bail.line: Oops! Slippery floors, folks. We'd sue, but, you know.
And down he goes in front of everyone. Mortifying.
He fell! Somebody find a wet floor sign. Does anybody still have a wet floor sign?
He's down! No, he's up. Disappointing.
Whoa! You break it, you bought it, Parker.
Ha! Mind the mannequins, they're rubbish at catching.
Oops. Listeners, he's tripped over his own feet. In a shop. Embarrassing.
Mind the floor, it's freshly ruined.

combo.line: Folks, this is better than the fountain show. There used to be a fountain show.
Ugh. Fine. That was good. Happy?
Folks, I hate to say it, but that was beautiful.
Look at him! It's like watching someone shop with a grudge.
That's it. Through the store, keep going.
Folks, I've never seen anyone move through a sale like that. And I've seen sales.
Good. Don't slow down for the drones.
Is he shopping or showing off? Bit of both, I think.

tape.line: ...this mall had the last clean taps in Port Calder. Somebody turned them off. Ask who.
...somebody's water trucks park behind this place every week. Clean ones. Not his. Count the barrels, I did.
...Hargrove's sold radios to half this city. They all still work. You just have to know how to listen.

radio.line: Hang on. Who's that in his ear? Is that... that's Margaret! Folks, she used to produce this show. Hi, Mags. Still sulking?
Ignore him.
You produced his show?
Twenty years ago. Later, Parker. Run.
Careful. Every shot you fire brings more of them.
Don't slow down in there. They'll run you down.
Big lads with the shields. Get round 'em, or shoot what the shield doesn't cover.
That drone's spotting you for the shooters. Knock it down if you can.
